enchantments.tooltip: +7 Enhancement Bonus: +7 enhancement bonus to Armor Class.
Haste Guard: When you are hit by enemies, there is a chance you will be Hasted, quickening your attack and movement speed.
Armor-Piercing 15%: Passive: +15% Enhancement bonus to Fortification Bypass. (Fortification Bypass makes your attacks ignore a percentage of enemy Fortification.)

Relentless Fury: While this item is equipped, any killing blows you strike against enemies may drive you into a furious rage, providing a 5% Enhancement damage bonus to your melee, ranged and unarmed attacks for 30 seconds. Slaying weaker opponents has a reduced chance of producing this effect.
Acid Resistance +40: Passive: +40 Enhancement bonus to your Acid Resistance.
This relic is attuned to heroic actions.

enchantments.tooltip: Draconic Ferocity: While an Epic-level Helm of the Black Dragon is equipped at the same time as a Flawless Black Dragonscale Armor, you will gain a +3% artifact bonus to melee Doublestrike chance and a +2 artifact bonus to damage with ranged or thrown weapons.
